$schema.description: The URI of the schema that this manifest adheres to.

description.description: A brief description of the module.

resources.description: Static resources to include in the documentation pages.

css.description: List of CSS file paths to include in the documentation pages.

js.description: List of JavaScript file paths to include in the documentation pages.

favicon-ico.description: Path to the favicon in .ico format.

favicon-svg.description: Path to the favicon in .svg format.

unspecified.description: Any additional resources that don't fit into the predefined categories (css, js, favicon-ico, favicon-svg) can be added here. Each key is a custom identifier for the resource, and its value should follow the same structure as defined in the 'resource' definition in $defs. This allows for flexible inclusion of various types of resources as needed by the module.

replacements.description: List of replacements to perform in the documentation pages. Each key is a placeholder to replace, and its value defines the replacement content and rules. If a key starts with 'regex^', it will be treated as a regular expression pattern, according to the JavaScript RegExp syntax, and all occurrences matching the pattern will be replaced. Else, the key will be treated as a simple string placeholder, and only exact matches will be replaced.

data.description: Various data that can be used by the JavaScript code in the documentation pages. The structure of this object is flexible and can contain any key-value pairs as needed by the module's scripts.

is-folder.description: Indicates whether the 'path' is a folder (true) or a single file (false). If true, all files within the specified folder will be included as resources.

folder-depth.description: If 'is-folder' is true, this property specifies how many levels of subfolders to include. A value of 0 means only the files directly within the specified folder will be included, while a value of 1 means files in the specified folder and its immediate subfolders will be included, and so on. -1 can be used to include all levels of subfolders.

copy-name.description: If specified, the resource will be copied to the output directory with this name instead of its original name. This can be useful for avoiding name conflicts or for providing a more descriptive name for the resource in the documentation.

replacement.description: Each replacement can be defined as a simple string (the replacement value) or as an object with more detailed configuration options.

value.description: Path to the file containing the replacement content or the replacement string itself.

is-file.description: Indicates whether the 'value' is a file path (true) or a direct string replacement (false). If the value is true and the file cannot be found, the replacement will be skipped without causing an error.

only-first-occurrence.description: If true, only the first occurrence of the placeholder in each file will be replaced.

only-last-occurrence.description: If true, only the last occurrence of the placeholder in each file will be replaced.

only-in-files.description: If specified, the replacement will only be applied to files whose names are in this list. If empty, the replacement will be applied to all files.

exclude-files.description: If specified, the replacement will not be applied to files whose names are in this list. If empty, the replacement will be applied to all files.
